messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: INC-2026-882 — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (P1). 5xx pct ~18% over the last 5m, latency p95 doubled. Pager sent to oncall. Link: https://internal.incidents/redwood/INC-2026-882 :rotating_light:

maria: I'm primary for the night shift, picking this up. confirming impact window now. will post quick summary.

jake: I'm secondary — available if you need help with scaling or region routing.

maria: quick numbers: seeing 18% 5xx for model-serving workers behind rtm-serve-eu-west-1. Total request volume steady, error responses are backend 503s from worker pool. Sample logs show OOM traces and "kvcache eviction" warnings.

alex: tagging runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/model-serving/outages. first mitigation: drain workers with high OOM and spin new nodes, fallback to model-quant-small if needed.

maria: actions in progress:
- scaled worker pool +30% in eu-west-1 (autoscaler override)
- draining three nodes that showed repeated OOMs
- enabled model fallback policy to model-v1-quant-8bit-small (will route slowly)
- creating a support ticket with infra to check node-level memory paging

sunita: Customer impact: affected requests are predominantly from a handful of customers on Dedicated and Hosted users in eu-west-1. Estimated affected keys: cust-981, cust-214, cust-332. Notified CSMs for those accounts and opened ops tickets.

maria: mitigation commands used (copy-paste):
```bash
# force scale up to 120 workers temporarily
redwoodctl scale --cluster rtm-serve-eu-west-1 --replicas 120 --reason "INC-2026-882 temporary scale up"
# drain a node
redwoodctl node drain node-eu-45 --cluster rtm-serve-eu-west-1
```

jake: FYI ran a quick health probe across regions. eu-central appears healthy. we can route low-priority traffic there if fallback required.

alex: note about fallback: model-quant-small reduces per-token quality slightly, so enabling only for non-SLA or lower-priority routes is recommended. config path: /deploy/configs/routing/fallbacks.yaml

maria: currently seeing errors drop to ~9% after scale/drain. latency p95 trending down but still ~2x normal. I left the fallback enabled but inactive for 5% of traffic to test.

oncall-rotation-bot: Reminder: new primary handoff scheduled at 2026-03-15T08:00:00Z — @jake will become primary.

maria: Handoff notes for incoming oncall (Jake):
- What happened: sudden rise in worker OOMs starting 2026-03-15T06:12Z; triggered 5xx spike on /v1/generate in eu-west-1.
- Active alerts: INC-2026-882 (5xx spike), Metric alert: eu-west-1.worker.oom.rate > 5% (firing).
- Actions taken: scaled pool +30%, drained 3 bad nodes, enabled partial fallback, notified infra and CSMs.
- Current mitigations: draining nodes, autoscaler override, fallback routing live for 5% of traffic.
- Customer impact: medium (some requests failing for select customers). Support tickets created and CSMs looped in.
- Runbook pointers: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/model-serving/outages and the "OOM investigation" section.
- Commands and playbook: use redwoodctl as above; check node logs at /var/log/serve/node-*.log and the KV cache metrics dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/kvcache/kvcache-eu-west
- Escalation: if 5xx > 15% for > 10m escalate to infra oncall (pager duty: infra-oncall) and exec oncall.

jake: Got it. I'll take primary at the handoff and will continue monitoring for 2h. Quick note: we still have a coverage gap for low-priority reroute automation — current playbook needs manual flip. I'll add a short automation PR to allow safety-gated reroute.

maria: Outstanding items for next shift:
- Confirm whether drained nodes have leaking processes (ask infra to run `pmap` and coredump check)
- Verify autoscaler policy and revert override when stable
- Validate fallback quality metrics and rollback if unacceptable
- Postmortem owners: volunteer? I can start draft, but need someone from infra to co-own (Alex?)

alex: I'll co-own the postmortem and follow up with infra ops for node diagnostics.

sunita: I'll coordinate customer comms and CSM follow-ups. Planned message to affected customers drafted, will share for review.

jake: I'll keep monitoring and will escalate if any regression. Leaving these bookmarks:
- incident ticket: https://internal.incidents/redwood/INC-2026-882
- fallback config diff: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/commit/8f9c2e

maria: leaving a final quick status: ERROR RATE 5xx = 6.2% (down from 18%), p95 latency = 1.8s (baseline 0.9s). continuing watch. handing primary to @jake at scheduled handoff. :white_check_mark:

jake: taking over. thanks @maria — I'll ping in this thread if anything changes.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from alex, :pray: from sunita)
